title: tcv2-community — Tier-2 featurized trace contribution (draft v0)
description: DIRECTION.md §6 Tier 2: chunk embeddings + trace graph structure + tool names + token counts + mechanically-computed is_needed labels + outcome. Raw source code and prompts are UNREPRESENTABLE by construction: every string field is an enum, a constrained identifier, or a timestamp; additionalProperties is false everywhere. Evolves only with re-consent (a version bump re-prompts).

contract_version.description: Consent is bound to this exact value; any change re-prompts.

contributor_id.description: Provenance tag so purge is honorable (§6 pipeline step 3).

outcome.description: Outcome signal used for is_needed labeling; enum, never free text.

config_sha8.description: Hash of the serving config; identifies the (harness, model, config) cell for tau calibration.

parent_chunk_id.description: Trace-graph edge (structure only; the graph carries no content).

embedder_id.description: Which embedder produced the vector; checkpoints are matched to it (§5).

vector.description: The vector itself, never the text. Disclosed as a mitigation, not anonymity (§6).

structural_features.description: Mechanically-computed numeric features only (depth, fanout, recency, ...). Numbers can't smuggle prompts.

tool_name.description: Tool identifier, constrained to identifier characters — not a free-text field.

is_needed.description: Mechanically-computed label (§6): was this chunk needed downstream.
